name: Cell
description: Parameters of periodic boundary conditions<sect-PBC>. Only applies if O.isPeriodic==True.

attributes.name: trsf
attributes.description: Current transformation matrix of the cell $ mat{F}$ giving current Cell vector $d vec{x}$ from its reference state $d vec{X}$ as per $d vec{x} = mat{F} d vec{X}$. Obtained from time integration of velGrad$ times mat{F}$ as detailed in the :ref:`documentation<sect-PBC>` during the prologue of a YADE iteration (before the O.engines loop). (auto-updated)

attributes.name: refHSize
attributes.description: Reference cell configuration, only used with OpenGLRenderer.dispScale. Updated automatically when hSize or trsf is assigned directly; also modified by yade.utils.setRefSe3 (called e.g. by the ``Reference`` button in the UI).

attributes.name: hSize
attributes.description: Base cell vectors (columns of the matrix), updated at every step from velGrad (trsf accumulates applied velGrad transformations). Setting *hSize* during a simulation is not supported by most contact laws, it is only meant to be used at iteration 0 before any interactions have been created.

attributes.name: prevHSize
attributes.description: hSize from the previous step, used in the definition of relative velocity across periods.

attributes.name: velGrad
attributes.description: Velocity gradient of the transformation of the Cell; used in NewtonIntegrator. Values of velGrad accumulate in trsf at every step. note: changing velGrad at the beginning of a timestep would lead to inaccurate integration for that step, as it should normally be changed after the contact laws (but before Newton). To avoid this problem, assignment is deferred automatically. The assigned value is internaly stored in Cell.nextVelGrad and will be applied right in time by Newton integrator. .. warning:: Assigning individual components as in `O.cell.velGrad[0,0]=1` is not possible (it will not return any error but it will have no effect). Instead, the whole matrix should be assigned, as in `O.cell.velGrad=Matrix3(...)`. Alternatively nextVelGrad can be assigned directly (both per-component or as a whole) and the effect should be the same.

attributes.name: prevVelGrad
attributes.description: Velocity gradient in the previous step.

attributes.name: homoDeform
attributes.description: If >0, deform (velGrad) the cell homothetically by adjusting positions and velocities of bodies. The velocity change is obtained by deriving the expression v=∇v.x with respect to time, where ∇v is the macroscopic velocity gradient, giving in an incremental form: Δv=Δ ∇v x + ∇v Δx across one DEM iteration. As a result, velocities are modified as soon as ``velGrad`` changes, according to the first term: Δv(t)=Δ ∇v x(t), while the 2nd term reflects a convective term: Δv'= ∇v v(t-dt/2). The second term is neglected if homoDeform=1. All terms are included if homoDeform=2 (default)

attributes.name: velGradChanged
attributes.description: true when velGrad has been changed manually (see also

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Current size of the cell, i.e. lengths of the 3 cell lateral vectors contained in Cell.hSize columns. (auto-updated)

attributes.name: refSize
attributes.description: Reference size of the cell (lengths of initial cell vectors, i.e. column norms of hSize). .. note:: Modifying this value is deprecated, use setBox instead.

attributes.name: unshearTrsf
attributes.description: Inverse of the current skew+rot transformation (no resize)

attributes.name: hSize0
attributes.description: Value of untransformed hSize with respect to current trsf (computed as trsf ⁻¹ × hSize).

methods.name: flipCell
methods.description: Flip periodic cell so that angles between $R^3$ axes and transformed axes are as small as possible, using the two following facts:1. repeating in $R^3$ space the corners of a periodic cell defines a regular grid; 2. two cells leading through this process to a unique grid are equivalent and can be flipped one over another. Flipping includes adjustment of Interaction.cellDist for interactions that cross the boundary and didn't before (or vice versa), and re-initialization of collider. See also :ref:`collision detection<sect-cell-approx-collision>`

methods.name: getDefGrad
methods.description: Returns trsf<Cell.trsf> = deformation gradient tensor $\mat{F}$ of the cell deformation (http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Finite_strain_theory)

methods.name: getEulerianAlmansiStrain
methods.description: Returns Eulerian-Almansi strain tensor $\mat{e}=\frac{1}{2}(\mat{I}-\mat{b}^{-1})=\frac{1}{2}(\mat{I}-(\mat{F}\mat{F}^T)^{-1})$ of the cell (http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Finite_strain_theory)

methods.name: getFluctuationVelocity
methods.description: get velocity fluctuation of a body, i.e. the velocity relative to mean field velocity: $\tilde{\vec{v} }= \vec{v} - (\nabla \vec{v}_m)\cdot \vec{x}$

methods.name: getLCauchyGreenDef
methods.description: Returns left Cauchy-Green deformation tensor $\mat{b}=\mat{F}\mat{F}^T$ of the cell (http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Finite_strain_theory)

methods.name: getLagrangianStrain
methods.description: Returns Lagrangian strain tensor $\mat{E}=\frac{1}{2}(\mat{C}-\mat{I})=\frac{1}{2}(\mat{F}^T\mat{F}-\mat{I})=\frac{1}{2}(\mat{U}^2-\mat{I})$ of the cell (http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Finite_strain_theory)

methods.name: getLeftStretch
methods.description: Returns left (spatial) stretch tensor of the cell (matrix $\mat{U}$ from polar decomposition $\mat{F}=\mat{RU}$ )

methods.name: getPolarDecOfDefGrad
methods.description: Returns orthogonal matrix $\mat{R}$ and symmetric positive semi-definite matrix $\mat{U}$ as polar decomposition of deformation gradient $\mat{F}$ of the cell ( $\mat{F}=\mat{RU}$ )

methods.name: getRCauchyGreenDef
methods.description: Returns right Cauchy-Green deformation tensor $\mat{C}=\mat{F}^T\mat{F}$ of the cell (http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Finite_strain_theory)

methods.name: getRightStretch
methods.description: Returns right (material) stretch tensor of the cell (matrix $\mat{V}$ from polar decomposition $\mat{F}=\mat{RU}=\mat{VR}\ \rightarrow\ \mat{V}=\mat{FR}^T$ )

methods.name: getRotation
methods.description: Returns rotation of the cell (orthogonal matrix $\mat{R}$ from polar decomposition $\mat{F}=\mat{RU}$ )

methods.name: getSmallStrain
methods.description: Returns small strain tensor $\mat{\varepsilon}=\frac{1}{2}(\mat{F}+\mat{F}^T)-\mat{I}$ of the cell (http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Finite_strain_theory)

methods.name: getSpin
methods.description: Returns the spin defined by the skew symmetric part of velGrad<Cell.velGrad>

methods.name: setBox
methods.description: Set Cell shape to be rectangular, with dimensions along axes specified by given argument. Shorthand for assigning diagonal matrix with respective entries to hSize<Cell.hSize>.

methods.name: shearPt
methods.description: Apply shear (cell skew+rot) on the point

methods.name: unshearPt
methods.description: Apply inverse shear on the point (removes skew+rot of the cell)

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Transform an arbitrary point into a point in the reference cell

methods.name: wrapPt
methods.description: Wrap point inside the reference cell, assuming the cell has no skew+rot.
